entities.summary: Chief Shafi Lawal Edu, popularly known as S.L. Edu, was a Nigerian businessman, environmentalist and conservationist from Epe, Lagos State. He founded the Nigerian Conservation Fund, a non-governmental organization involved in conservation projects, and was a former member of the council of the World Wildlife Fund.
